'''Moy-Ran Bostt''' was a [[Gender/Legends|man]] living on the same [[Planet/Legends|planet]] as the [[Farm/Legends|farm]] belonging to [[Armo Drane]] and his [[Marriage/Legends|wife]], [[Tso Sook Drane]]. Before Armo was sent to a [[Detention area|detention]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] via the [[Imperial prison barge]] [[Purge (prison barge)|''Purge'']] for committing a crime, Bostt was paid back money by the family with the profits from their farm season. In the post-post-script of a letter to Tso, to be delivered by a guard from ''Purge'' named [[Wembly]], Armo warned his wife that Bostt was a [[Gambler/Legends|piker]] who may try to swindle her into paying him again. The letter was recovered aboard ''Purge'' after its occupants were decimated by a [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|plague]] so it is unlikely the letter reached her before it was released to the public for academic purposes in relation to the history of ''Purge''.<ref name="Recovered Messages" />
